bodyText: Online Whiteboard & Online Collaboration Tool | RealtimeBoard Tour Cases Examples Customers Pricing Blog Log in Sign up Whiteboard. Finally in your browser. The simplest visual collaboration platform for agile product teams, ux/ui designers, project leaders, marketers and creatives. Watch the video Start collaborating now Over 900,000 project leaders, marketers, designers, developers and creatives trust us worldwide Collaboration made simple Use the infinite online whiteboard, a design thinking toolkit and real time collaboration features created with teams in mind. Organize your teamwork in a simple and visual way — from research and brainstorming to visualization and review. RealtimeBoard has helped us work across multiple sites around the world and has enabled us to be far more productive then before. Richard Davidson, Agile Project Manager at Skyscanner How it works Customer Journey Map Retrospective Fishbone diagram Business model canvas Mind map Start with familiar layouts Pick from our hand-crafted templates to fire up your teamwork, and get a head start on any task: brainstorming sessions, customer journey or user story maps, agile boards, retrospectives and others. Look at examples One stop place for all your information RealtimeBoard allows you to keep everything you need on a daily basis in one place. Use it to store post-it notes, images, videos, documents, diagrams, spreadsheets, Google Drive files and more. Perfect online whiteboard for Agile management Work with the features backlog, visualize tasks, make sizing exercises and hold retrospectives with your distributed team just like in front of your office whiteboard. Learn more Take your UX design process to the next level Manage all UX tasks with just one tool. Use the online whiteboard for research, ideation, building customer journey and user story maps, wireframing and a wide range of collaborative activities. Learn more Work within the team, and invite external collaborators Simple sharing options together with powerful collaboration features and integrations provide seamless communication and boost your productivity. Manage the big picture without losing the details See how your ideas and projects grow, iterate and stay organized. Zoom in and out to see the big picture, or go into important details whenever you need it. Works with tools that you use daily Keep your team on top of their game by building your workflow around a single tool. Get the most out of RealtimeBoard by connecting it to your favorite apps and services. Slack Send comments and mentions to Slack channels to get instantly notified about updates on the boards. JIRA Link boards to your JIRA issues to visualize anything. Share your vision with the whole team and get instant feedback. Google Drive Add your Google Docs and Spreadsheets on boards and save your boards to Google Drive easily. Dropbox Insert images, documents and other files from Dropbox to use them on the boards. Box Upload files directly from Box and work on them with your team in real time. OneDrive Work with your OneDrive files on the boards together with your team. Have a whiteboard at hand anywhere RealtimeBoard is a powerful digital whiteboard in your hands. Work in the office or run it on your phone or tablet while on the go.
